facts.fact: Communications Minister Samuel Nartey George told the Government Accountability Series that the Data Protection Commission recorded a 51.5 per cent increase in regulatory activity and a 98.4 per cent increase in newly registered data controllers in January-June 2026, with no decisions or sanctions given.

The Minister reported on 2026-09-07 that in the first half of 2026 the DPC's regulatory activity rose 51.5 per cent and newly registered data controllers rose 98.4 per cent, and that its 'Privacy is Personal' campaign reached an estimated 25 million people.

systems.tiers: national; five-region decentralisation to be completed by December 2026

note: Other items (Data Harmonisation Bill before Cabinet, DPC decentralisation commitment) are not facts on the general law's aspects; the Minister's claim about public confidence that data is protected by law states no event.
